name: Morpho Blue (singleton)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: owner() resolves to a real Gnosis Safe in one hop, fully closed - but by Morpho’s own immutable-core design, owner() can only set fees and enable new markets, never touch funds in existing markets directly.
narrative.tag: $3.90B TVL - largest target in this expansion
narrative.detail: Scored on the authority root mechanism itself (a Safe, same convention as every other Safe-rooted target in this project), not on the narrower operational blast radius - consistent with how Aerodrome’s pauser Safe below is also scored on the mechanism rather than its scope.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
